sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We spent a lot of time on features nobody used.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Two of the four features we shipped this quarter have almost no usage.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Every new feature now needs a small user test before we build it.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yes.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Usage of two of our four new features is close to zero.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We built them without testing the idea first.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: From now on, no feature gets built without a quick user test.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Agreed.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: How did the handover to engineering go?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Specs kept changing after work started.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: It caused a lot of rework.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We freeze the spec when engineering starts, and changes go to the next iteration.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: That'll help.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The specs changed after engineering started.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Lots of rework because of it.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Specs are frozen once engineering begins, and changes wait for the next iteration.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Customer interviews were great this quarter.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We did {NUMBER} of them, more than ever.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Did you say {NUMBER}?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We keep a fixed slot every week for customer interviews.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Love it.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We ran {NUMBER} customer interviews, a record for us.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Sorry, how many, {NUMBER}?

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: And they were really useful.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: So we block a weekly slot for them going forward.
